tasks.title: Model in-app notifications
tasks.description: Add server/src/models/notificationModel.ts: the four NOTIFICATION_TYPES, recipient/workspace/actor/task references, a 140-character summary of the task title, readAt, the (user, readAt, createdAt) index and the 90-day TTL index.

tasks.title: Model push subscriptions
tasks.description: Add server/src/models/pushSubscriptionModel.ts: one row per browser endpoint, unique https endpoint (max 2048), base64url p256dh/auth keys (max 200), user agent and lastUsedAt.

tasks.title: Write the pure notification rules
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/notify.ts rules: addedAssignees, planTaskNotifications, planCommentNotifications, resolveMentions, wantsEmail and wantsPush, keeping them free of HTTP and database access so server/src/__tests__/notify.test.ts can exercise them.

tasks.title: Implement delivery with the email channel
tasks.description: Add deliver(), notifyTaskEvents, notifyComment and loadMentionCandidates: filter recipients by current workspace membership, insert one row per recipient, then send email through utils/sendEmail.ts using a new notificationTemplate with escaped HTML. Add the comment excerpt for comment types and the $addToSet of the author into Task.watchers.

tasks.title: Implement the Web Push sender
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/webPush.ts: read VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY/VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY/VAPID_SUBJECT, expose getPublicKey/isPushConfigured, keep one sentence per notification type (pushSentence) and send to every device with a 24 h TTL, deleting the subscriptions reported as gone and never throwing.

tasks.title: Serve the caller's notifications
tasks.description: Add listNotifications, markNotificationRead and markAllNotificationsRead in server/src/controllers/notificationController.ts: scope by the caller and their remaining workspaces, cursor pagination with nextBefore, unread filter, unread total, projected actor/task key/workspace, idempotent reads and 404 for someone else's id.

tasks.title: Add the push endpoints
tasks.description: Implement getPushPublicKey, subscribePush and unsubscribePush: 503 while push is unconfigured, https endpoint and base64url key validation, upsert by endpoint so an endpoint moves to the caller, and delete scoped to the caller.

tasks.title: Store notification preferences on the profile
tasks.description: Add the notifications block to server/src/models/userModel.ts and updateNotifications to server/src/controllers/profileController.ts, applying only the provided keys and rejecting non-boolean values with 400.

tasks.title: Declare the routes and mount the router
tasks.description: Add server/src/routes/notificationRoutes.ts with the six routes behind protect (push routes declared before /:id/read) and mount it at /api/notifications in server/src/app.ts; expose PUT /api/profile/notifications in profileRoutes.ts.

tasks.title: Notify from the task write paths
tasks.description: Call notifyTaskEvents after task create, update (passing the previous assignees and status), duplicate and bulk status change in server/src/controllers/taskController.ts, so only added assignees and the transition into completed produce notifications.

tasks.title: Resolve mentions and notify comment readers
tasks.description: In server/src/controllers/taskExtrasController.ts resolve @mentions against workspace member names, store them on the comment and call notifyComment, which notifies mentions then the remaining owner/assignees/watchers once each and subscribes the author as a watcher.

tasks.title: Cover the rules and the API with tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__tests__/notify.test.ts for the pure rules and the delivery step, server/src/__integration__/notifications.test.ts for access, assignment, completion, comments, paging and isolation, and server/src/__integration__/push.test.ts for the disabled, subscription and delivery paths.

tasks.title: Build the notification feature module and bell
tasks.description: Add client/src/features/notifications (types, api, hooks/useNotificationFeed with the 60 s visible-tab poll, focus refetch and cross-list change event, components/NotificationBell and NotificationRow, lib/format) and render the bell from client/src/components/Sidebar.tsx.

tasks.title: Build the inbox page
tasks.description: Add client/src/pages/InboxPage.tsx and hooks/useNotificationInbox: all/unread filters, 20-item pages with a cursor, mark-one and mark-all with optimistic updates, empty, loading and error states.

tasks.title: Toast new notifications and autocomplete mentions
tasks.description: Add hooks/useNewNotificationToasts (at most three toasts, then a “+N more” toast, opening the item or the inbox) plus lib/newItems.ts and lib/mentions.ts, and use the mention helpers in the task comment box (client/src/features/tasks/components/TaskComments.tsx).

tasks.title: Add device settings and logout cleanup
tasks.description: Add components/PushDeviceSettings.tsx, lib/push.ts and hooks/usePushSubscription.ts, host the panel on client/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx, and unsubscribe this device when the user logs out (client/src/hooks/useAuthGuard.ts).
